The existential b depends on the universally quantified a.
One shared c is chosen before all t.
Same implication direction and inclusive inequalities.
The two occurrences of j have distinct local binders.
Same two binders, premise and conclusion.
V is explicitly defined for both consecutive pages; substitution is exact.
Square is multiplication of z by itself; nonnegative means at least zero.
Both endpoints and the implication are preserved.
A dependent witness becomes a single bound for all naturals.
Implication is reversed; t=5 separates the claims.
The stated integer domain is narrowed to naturals.

Strict inequality is changed to equality.
